# Arizona Trauma Institute

> A trauma-focused mental health and training organization providing clinical guidance, continuing education, and psychological support for trauma recovery and PTSD.

Arizona Trauma Institute serves as a comprehensive resource for trauma treatment, professional training, and organizational leadership in the Phoenix area. The institute combines clinical expertise with educational services to support both individuals recovering from trauma and professionals seeking continuing education in trauma-informed care.

## Key Topics

- PTSD
- Car Accidents
- Trauma Healing
- Mental Health
- Resources & Assets

## Clinical Guides & Treatment Resources

- [PTSD and Car Accidents](https://aztrauma.org/ptsd-and-car-accidents): Guide on PTSD following car accidents with legal and psychological perspectives.
- [The Hidden Power of Resources & Assets](https://aztrauma.org/the-hidden-power-of-resources-and-assets): Guide on leveraging resources and strengths for trauma healing and recovery.

## Leadership & Organization

- [Welcome Our Newly Appointed Co-CEO](https://aztrauma.org/newly-appointed-co-ceo-candice-liozu): Announcement of Candice Liozu's appointment as Co-CEO of Arizona Trauma Institute.
